criteria.criterion: CLI, MCP, Python, and direct reconciler paths produce equivalent non-secret behavior from the approved precedence/root contract; a captured operation is stable across environment/file/cwd mutation while the next operation observes the change.
Every affected consumer receives an immutable projection/runtime binding and no in-progress operation rereads ambient state.

A portable-local-and-CI AST ownership gate derives names from authoritative registries and rejects direct/aliased `load_config`, ambient config/credential reads, backend reloads, and configurable adapter defaults below approved seams; exact path/symbol+rationale exceptions contain no post-cutover legacy entry.

The LLM cutover injects provider-native auth/session capability only through the landed RP-01 `ProviderSession` builders; RP-01's one-run/one-Agent request budget, complete-or-omit retry history, cache/accounting, typed exhaustion, final artifacts, candidate tracing, usage, and failure behavior remain green in authoritative offline oracles and bounded live Anthropic/Bedrock cache/auth canaries.

Git and bridge factories preserve provider-native auth lifecycles and instantiate only the selected integration; missing/conflicting decision-bearing auth fails before network/write without anonymous, cross-provider, or alternate-principal fallback.

Secret canaries are absent from repr, equality/hash, serialization, snapshots, fingerprints, caches, provenance, exceptions, logs, output, argv, URL/query strings, subprocess siblings, and CLI/MCP schemas, verified at behavioral boundaries.

Same-capability children preserve unknown ambient/native-chain variables, owning children receive only their overlay, unrelated siblings lose exact Rebar-declared secret names, and concurrent operations observe no global environment mutation.

Op-cert enforces its exclusive startup sources, fails invalid composition before service work, uses a stable process-owned 0700/0600 copy and context-local signer, observes replacement only after restart, deletes only its copy, and has no application runtime SSM/boto3/region dependency.

Generated config/security/operator docs cover precedence, lifecycles, restart/redeploy rotation, provider ownership, observability's exception, subprocess limitations, and deliberate behavior deltas; drift checks detect schema/docs divergence.
Legacy ambient/per-job composition is removed only after focused suites and bounded live paths pass; rollback retains accurate non-secret diagnostics.
